sloka: स्तुतिभिः च अनुरूपाभिर् आनर्च आयत लोचना ।ज्वलनम् समुपादाय ब्राह्मणेन महात्मना ॥२-२५-२७॥
transliteration: stutibhiḥ ca anurūpābhir ānarca āyata locanā ।jvalanam samupādāya brāhmaṇena mahātmanā ॥2-25-27॥

translations.english: After collecting the sacred fire through great brahmins she duly offered oblations to the gods for the welfare of Rama.
